notes.title: Heavy Rain update: improvement of Simplified Chinese
notes.content:
Dear Chinese players,

We have fixed the missing characters/words issue that was reported by many of you for Heavy Rain.
The game has been updated on July 15, and the fix is already available for everyone.
We are happy to announce that you will now be able to enjoy the game better in your native language.
Thank you for your feedback!

The Quantic Dream team
